import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountAccountCenter } from '../templates/account/center/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountAccountCenter(element, { i18n, inheritAppearance: true }, onError);
	return result;
}

});
export function useAccountI18n() {
	return useAsamProI18n(accountMessageDefaults);
}

import { computed, reactive, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n, AsamI18nCall } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { accountMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { safeReturnPath, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	Registration,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	Verification,
	WriteResult
} from './Types.js';

const emptySettings = (): AccountSettings => ({
	displayName: '',
	email: '',
	phone: '',
	language: 'zh-CN',
	notifications: false,
	digest: false
});
const text = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '');
export function safeProfile(value: AccountProfile): AccountProfile {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		organization: text(value.organization),
		role: text(value.role),
		joined: text(value.joined),
		avatar: safeAccountUrl(value.avatar),
		website: safeAccountUrl(value.website)
	};
}
/** No data/blob/protocol-relative URLs. Host should restrict remote hosts further. */
export function safeAccountUrl(value: unknown): string | undefined {
	// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Reject URL control characters, as before.
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || /[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(value)) return;
	if (value.startsWith('/') && !value.startsWith('//') && !/%[0-9a-f]{2}/i.test(value))
		return value;
	try {
		const url = new URL(value);
		return url.protocol === 'https:' && !url.username && !url.password ? url.href : undefined;
	} catch {
		return;
	}
}
function copySettings(value: AccountSettings): AccountSettings {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),
		notifications: value.notifications === true,
		digest: value.digest === true,
		...(typeof value.biography === 'string' ? { biography: value.biography } : {}),
		...(typeof value.officeArea === 'string' ? { officeArea: value.officeArea } : {})
	};
}
type MessageIssue = ReturnType<typeof createAsamMessageIssue>;
function feedback<Field extends string>(owner?: AsamI18n) {
	const scope = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, accountMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const message = ref('');
	const source = shallowRef<MessageIssue>();
	const sources = shallowRef<Partial<Record<Field, MessageIssue>>>({});
	const errors = ref<Partial<Record<Field, string>>>({});
	function setMessage(legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall | []) {
		message.value = legacy;
		source.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	return {
		message,
		errors,
		sources,
		setMessage,
		displayMessage: computed(() =>
			scope && source.value ? formatFieldIssue(source.value, scope) : message.value
		),
		displayErrors: computed(
			() =>
				Object.fromEntries(
					Object.entries(errors.value).map(([key, value]) => [
						key,
						scope && sources.value[key as Field]
							? formatFieldIssue(sources.value[key as Field]!, scope)
							: value
					])
				) as Partial<Record<Field, string>>
		),
		dispose: () => scope?.dispose()
	};
}
export function registrationIssues(
	host: AccountHost,
	value: Registration & { confirm: string },
	sources: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: RegistrationField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_.-]{3,40}$/u.test(value.account))
		add(
			'account',
			'用户名需为3至40个字母、数字或 _ . -',
			'app.templates.account.accountInvalid'
		);
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.password.length < (host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8))
		add(
			'password',
			`密码至少${host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8}位`,
			'app.templates.account.passwordShort',
			{ minimum: host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8 }
		);
	if (value.password !== value.confirm)
		add('confirm', '两次输入的密码不一致', 'app.templates.account.passwordMismatch');
	if (host.registration?.requireConsent !== false && !value.consent)
		add('consent', '请先同意账户使用条款', 'app.templates.account.consentRequired');
	const hostErrors = host.registration?.validate?.(value);
	for (const key of Object.keys(hostErrors ?? {})) delete sources[key as RegistrationField];
	return { ...errors, ...hostErrors };
}
export function settingsIssues(
	value: AccountSettings,
	host: AccountHost,
	sources: Partial<Record<SettingsField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<SettingsField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: SettingsField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!value.displayName.trim() || value.displayName.length > 60)
		add('displayName', '显示名需为1至60个字符', 'app.templates.account.nameInvalid');
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.phone && !/^[+\d ()-]{5,30}$/.test(value.phone))
		add('phone', '请填写有效联系电话或留空', 'app.templates.account.phoneInvalid');
	if (
		!(host.languages ?? [{ value: 'zh-CN' }, { value: 'en' }]).some(
			(i) => i.value === value.language
		)
	)
		add('language', '请选择支持的语言', 'app.templates.account.languageInvalid');
	return errors;
}

/** Page-owned requests only. Security/transport state machines remain in 033/035. */
function owner(host: AccountHost, invalidate: () => void) {
	let version = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	const requests = new Set<AbortController>();
	function clear() {
		++version;
		const prior = [...requests];
		requests.clear();
		invalidate();
		for (const request of prior) request.abort();
	}
	const remove = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const stop = watch(
		() => {
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			return JSON.stringify([
				state.epoch,
				state.status,
				state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject)
			]);
		},
		clear,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		clear,
		request(operationId: string, protectedRead = false): AccountRequest & { release(): void } {
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requests.add(controller);
			const revision = version;
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			const identity = state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject);
			return {
				operationId,
				signal: controller.signal,
				isCurrent: () =>
					!disposed &&
					!controller.signal.aborted &&
					revision === version &&
					(!protectedRead ||
						(host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated' &&
							!!host.security.state.value.subject &&
							host.security.state.value.epoch === state.epoch &&
							scopeKey(host.security.state.value.subject) === identity)),
				release: () => requests.delete(controller)
			};
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			remove();
			clear();
		}
	};
}

/** 可选设置面板复用同一页面请求归属，不另建安全或写入状态机。 */
export { owner as createAccountRequestScope };

export function createRegistration(host: AccountHost, i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	const display = feedback<RegistrationField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const draft = reactive<Registration & { confirm: string }>({
		account: '',
		email: '',
		password: '',
		confirm: '',
		consent: false
	});
	const status = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const operationId = ref('');
	const secretClear = () => {
		draft.password = '';
		draft.confirm = '';
	};
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		Object.assign(draft, { account: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '', consent: false });
		status.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
	});
	function accept(result: WriteResult<RegistrationField>) {
		status.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure') setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('提交结果待核实，请勿重复注册', 'app.templates.account.registrationUnknown');
		else
			setMessage(
				'请检查标出的字段后重新填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.registrationFields'
			);
	}
	async function submit(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown', 'success'].includes(status.value)) return false;
		try {
			sources.value = {};
			errors.value = registrationIssues(host, draft, sources.value);
		} catch {
			setMessage('字段校验未能完成', 'app.templates.account.validationFailed');
			return false;
		}
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			status.value = 'field-error';
			return false;
		}
		const input: Registration = {
			account: draft.account,
			email: draft.email,
			password: draft.password,
			consent: draft.consent
		};
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		secretClear();
		try {
			const result = await host.services.register(input, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			input.password = '';
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || status.value !== 'unknown' || !host.services.verifyRegistration)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.verifyRegistration(operationId.value, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					status.value = 'idle';
					setMessage(
						'已核实未写入，可重新填写密码后提交',
						'app.templates.account.registrationNotWritten'
					);
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		draft,
		status,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		submit,
		verify,
		secretClear,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

type AccountNotificationField = 'notifications' | 'digest';
type LocalNotificationField = 'projectUpdates' | 'systemNotices';
export type NotificationChange = {
	field: AccountNotificationField | LocalNotificationField;
	value: boolean;
};

/** Optional page-local draft companion; never adds keys to AccountSettings or its payload. */
export interface AccountSettingsCompanion {
	dirty(): boolean;
	loaded(operationId: string): void;
	capture(operationId: string, notification?: NotificationChange): void;
	accept(operationId: string): void;
	rollbackNotification?(operationId: string): void;
	revert(): void;
	clear(): void;
}
export function createAccountData(
	host: AccountHost,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	companion?: AccountSettingsCompanion
) {
	const display = feedback<SettingsField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const profile = ref<AccountProfile | null>(null);
	const profileStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty' | 'error'>('idle');
	const draft = reactive(emptySettings());
	function replaceDraft(value: AccountSettings) {
		delete draft.biography;
		delete draft.officeArea;
		Object.assign(draft, value);
	}
	const original = ref(emptySettings());
	const settingsStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('idle');
	const saveStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const displayStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
	const operationId = ref('');
	let savedPayload: AccountSettings | undefined;
	let savedNotification: NotificationChange | undefined;
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'idle';
		replaceDraft(emptySettings());
		original.value = emptySettings();
		settingsStatus.value = 'idle';
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
		savedPayload = undefined;
		savedNotification = undefined;
		companion?.clear();
	});
	const dirty = computed(
		() => JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(original.value) || !!companion?.dirty()
	);
	const subject = () =>
		host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated'
			? host.security.state.value.subject
			: null;
	const allowed = (write = false) =>
		host.security.check({ permission: write ? 'account:write' : 'account:read', write }) ===
		'allowed';
	let profileRevision = 0,
		settingsRevision = 0;
	async function loadProfile(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (blocked || !person || !allowed()) return;
		const revision = ++profileRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.profile(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision && allowed()) {
				profile.value = result && safeProfile(result);
				profileStatus.value = result ? 'ready' : 'empty';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision) profileStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function loadSettings(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			saveStatus.value === 'unknown' ||
			dirty.value
		)
			return;
		const revision = ++settingsRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		settingsStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.settings(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision && allowed()) {
				original.value = copySettings(result);
				replaceDraft(original.value);
				companion?.loaded(request.operationId);
				settingsStatus.value = 'ready';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision)
				settingsStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	function revert(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)) return;
		replaceDraft(original.value);
		companion?.revert();
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
	}
	function accept(result: WriteResult<SettingsField>) {
		saveStatus.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedNotification)
			setMessage('通知偏好已保存', 'app.templates.account.notificationSaved');
		else if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure')
			setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('保存结果待核实，请勿再次保存', 'app.templates.account.saveUnknown');
		else setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedPayload) {
			original.value = copySettings(savedPayload);
			if (!savedNotification) replaceDraft(original.value);
			companion?.accept(operationId.value);
		} else if (result.status !== 'unknown') rollbackNotification();
	}
	function rollbackNotification() {
		const field = savedNotification?.field;
		if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') draft[field] = original.value[field];
		if (field) companion?.rollbackNotification?.(operationId.value);
	}
	async function save(blocked = false, notification?: NotificationChange) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed(true) ||
			settingsStatus.value !== 'ready' ||
			(!notification && !dirty.value) ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)
		)
			return false;
		const payload = notification ? copySettings(original.value) : copySettings(draft);
		const field = notification?.field;
		if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest')) {
			if (payload[field] === notification.value) return false;
			payload[field] = notification.value;
		} else if (notification && !companion) return false;
		sources.value = {};
		errors.value = settingsIssues(notification ? payload : draft, host, sources.value);
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			saveStatus.value = 'field-error';
			if (notification) setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
			return false;
		}
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		savedPayload = payload;
		savedNotification = notification;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		try {
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed(true)) return false;
			companion?.capture(operationId.value, notification);
			if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest'))
				draft[field] = notification.value;
			const result = await host.services.save(person, savedPayload, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'unknown' ||
			!host.services.verifySave
		)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result: Verification<SettingsField> = await host.services.verifySave(
				person,
				operationId.value,
				request
			);
			if (request.isCurrent() && allowed()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					rollbackNotification();
					saveStatus.value = 'idle';
					setMessage('已核实未写入，可重新保存', 'app.templates.account.saveNotWritten');
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function refreshDisplay(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'success' ||
			displayStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			!host.services.refreshDisplay
		)
			return;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		displayStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			await host.services.refreshDisplay(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		profile,
		profileStatus,
		draft,
		original,
		dirty,
		settingsStatus,
		saveStatus,
		displayStatus,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		allowed,
		loadProfile,
		loadSettings,
		revert,
		save,
		verify,
		refreshDisplay,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

export function loginDestination(host: AccountHost, value: unknown) {
	const path = safeReturnPath(value, '/account/profile');
	return host.canNavigate(path) ? path : undefined;
}

import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;
import type { SecurityRequest, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

export type AccountFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type AccountPage = 'login' | 'register' | 'profile' | 'settings';
export interface LoginCredentials {
	account: string;
	password: string;
}
export interface Registration extends LoginCredentials {
	email: string;
	consent: boolean;
}
export interface AccountSettings {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	language: string;
	notifications: boolean;
	digest: boolean;
	/** 可选前端资料扩展；未接入的宿主继续只返回原六字段。 */
	biography?: string;
	officeArea?: string;
}
/** Display allowlist. Map backend DTOs at the host boundary. */
export interface AccountProfile {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	organization: string;
	role: string;
	joined: string;
	avatar?: string;
	website?: string;
}
export type RegistrationField = 'account' | 'email' | 'password' | 'confirm' | 'consent';
export type SettingsField = keyof AccountSettings;
/** Messages are display-safe host text, never raw server exceptions/DTOs. */
export type WriteResult<K extends string> =
	| { status: 'success'; message: string }
	| { status: 'field-error'; fields: Partial<Record<K, string>> }
	| { status: 'failure'; message: string }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export type Verification<K extends string> = WriteResult<K> | { status: 'not-written' };
export interface AccountRequest extends SecurityRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface AccountServices {
	/** Host must gate authentication/storage side effects with BOTH requests' isCurrent. */
	login(credentials: Readonly<LoginCredentials>, request: AccountRequest): Promise<boolean>;
	register(
		input: Readonly<Registration>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>>;
	profile(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountProfile | null>;
	settings(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountSettings>;
	save(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		settings: Readonly<AccountSettings>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<SettingsField>>;
	verifyRegistration?(
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
	verifySave?(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<SettingsField>>;
	/** Refresh the host's display projection only. Must not save again or mutate page drafts. */
	refreshDisplay?(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<void>;
}
export interface AccountHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	services: AccountServices;
	/** Stable id for one mutation. Generate once, preserve through unknown/verification. */
	operationId(): string;
	/** Explicit host allowlist. safeReturnPath is always applied first. */
	canNavigate(path: string): boolean;
	navigate(path: string): void | Promise<void>;
	/** An escalation action, never an implicit retry. Receives no secrets or payload. */
	resolveUnknown(kind: 'register' | 'save', operationId: string): void;
	registration?: {
		accountLabel?: string;
		minimumPasswordLength?: number;
		requireConsent?: boolean;
		validate?(
			input: Readonly<Registration & { confirm: string }>
		): Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>>;
	};
	languages?: readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
}
export interface AccountPageProps {
	host: AccountHost;
	brand?: string;
	accountLabel?: string;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	returnPath?: unknown;
}
export interface AccountPageEvents {
	page: [page: AccountPage];
	/** Register/save emit once per operation, on direct or verified success in the current page. */
	completed: [kind: 'login' | 'register' | 'save'];
}
export interface AccountPageExpose {
	clear(): void;
}

									><WebsiteAsamRadioGroup
										:model-value="fixture.controls.mode"

										class="preview-choice-grid"
										:ariaLabel="String(t('service'))"
										><WebsiteAsamRadioItem
											v-for="mode in centerModes"
											:key="mode"
											:value="mode"
											border
											>{{ t(mode) }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
										></WebsiteAsamRadioGroup

								<AsamButton @click="fixture.security.expire()" type="primary">{{

								><AsamButton @click="fixture.security.restore()" type="primary">{{
									t('restore')
								}}</AsamButton
								><AsamCheckboxItem
									border
									:model-value="fixture.controls.readOnly"
									@update:model-value="fixture.readOnly()"
									>{{ t('toggleReadonly') }}</AsamCheckboxItem
								><AsamCheckboxItem
									border
									:model-value="fixture.controls.denied"
									@update:model-value="fixture.toggleDenied()"
									>{{ t('toggleDenied') }}</AsamCheckboxItem
								><AsamCheckboxItem
									border
									:model-value="fixture.controls.disabled"
									@update:model-value="fixture.toggleDisabled()"
									>{{ t('toggleDisabled') }}</AsamCheckboxItem
								>
							</nav>
						</details>
					</section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
				></Teleport
			><CenterPage
				:host="fixture.host"
				:content-host="fixture.contentHost"
				:path="fixture.router.currentRoute.value.path"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="fixture.controls.disabled"
				:readonly="fixture.controls.readOnly"
			/></div
	></component>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {} from './Models.js';
import type { CenterFixture } from './Fixture.js';
import { centerModes } from './Fixture.js';
import { useCenterText } from './I18n.js';
import CenterPage from './CenterPage.vue';
const props = defineProps<{
	fixture: CenterFixture;
	externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
	inheritAppearance?: boolean;
	onLocale?: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => void;
}>();
const { i18n, t } = useCenterText();
const theme = ref<'light' | 'dark'>('light'),
	size = ref<AsamFlowSize>('default');
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'] as const;
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (sizes.some((item) => item === value)) size.value = value as AsamFlowSize;
}
function setMode(value: unknown) {
	if (centerModes.includes(value as (typeof centerModes)[number]))
		props.fixture.setMode(value as (typeof centerModes)[number]);
}
onBeforeUnmount(props.fixture.dispose);
</script>

										formatDate(selected.record.date)
									}}</time
									><span
										>{{ t('views') }}
										{{ number.format(selected.record.views) }}</span
									>
								</div></template
							>
							<h2 v-else>{{ t('notFound') }}</h2>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								:size="size"
								:disabled="disabled"
								@click="back"
								>{{ t('back') }}</AsamButton
							>
						</section></AsamCard
					>
				</div>
				<p v-if="navigationFailed" role="alert">{{ t('navigationFailed') }}</p></template
			></template
		></ProfilePanel
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAvatar,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamDescriptions,
	AsamDescriptionsItem,
	AsamDivider,
	AsamLink,
	AsamTabs,
	AsamTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCardGroup } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountPageProps } from '../Types.js';
import type { CenterContentHost, CenterTab } from './Types.js';
import { centerPath, centerTabs } from './Data.js';
import { createCenterRead } from './Read.js';
import { useCenterText } from './I18n.js';
import ProfilePanel from '../shared/ProfilePanel.vue';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<AccountPageProps & { contentHost: CenterContentHost; path?: string }>(),
	{ size: 'default', path: '/account/center' }
);
const { i18n, t } = useCenterText();
const read = createCenterRead(props.host, () => props.contentHost);
const tab = ref<CenterTab>('articles');
watch(
	[() => props.host.security, () => props.host.security.state.value.epoch],
	() => {
		tab.value = 'articles';
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
const navigationFailed = ref(false);
const teamsExpanded = ref(false);
const teamsId = useId();
const teamsToggleAttrs = computed<Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-controls' | 'aria-expanded'>>(() => ({
	'aria-controls': teamsId,
	'aria-expanded': teamsExpanded.value
}));
const detailHeading = ref<HTMLElement>();
const number = computed(() => new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.locale.value));
const tabs = computed(() => centerTabs.map((value) => ({ value, label: t(value) })));
const records = computed(() => read.content.value?.[tab.value] ?? []);
function setTab(value: unknown) {
	if (centerTabs.includes(value as CenterTab)) tab.value = value as CenterTab;
}
const selected = computed(() => {
	for (const kind of centerTabs) {
		const record = read.content.value?.[kind].find(
			(item) => centerPath(kind, item.id) === props.path
		);
		if (record) return { tab: kind, record };
	}
	return undefined;
});
function formatDate(value: string) {
	return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(i18n.locale.value, {
		timeZone: 'UTC',
		year: 'numeric',
		month: 'short',
		day: 'numeric'
	}).format(new Date(value + 'T00:00:00Z'));
}
function canOpen(kind: CenterTab, id: string) {
	const path = centerPath(kind, id);
	return !!path && props.host.canNavigate(path);
}
async function navigate(path: string) {
	if (
		props.disabled ||
		!read.content.value ||
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) !== 'allowed' ||
		!props.host.canNavigate(path)
	)
		return;
	navigationFailed.value = false;
	const snapshot = read.content.value;
	try {
		await props.host.navigate(path);
	} catch {
		if (snapshot === read.content.value) navigationFailed.value = true;
	}
}
function open(kind: CenterTab, id: string) {
	const path = centerPath(kind, id);
	if (path) void navigate(path);
}
function back() {
	void navigate('/account/center');
}
watch(
	() => props.path,
	async () => {
		navigationFailed.value = false;
		await nextTick();
		detailHeading.value?.focus();
	}
);
onBeforeUnmount(read.dispose);
watch(
	() => props.disabled,
	(disabled) => {
		if (disabled) read.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	read.content,
	(value) => {
		if (value) return;
		navigationFailed.value = false;
		teamsExpanded.value = false;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
</script>

import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { CenterContent, CenterRecord, CenterTab } from './Types.js';

export const centerTabs: readonly CenterTab[] = ['articles', 'projects', 'applications'];
export function centerIdentity(subject: Pick<SecuritySubject, 'id' | 'scope'>) {
	return JSON.stringify([subject.id, subject.scope.tenant, subject.scope.organization]);
}
function text(value: unknown, max = 500): string {
	if (
		typeof value !== 'string' ||
		value.length > max ||
		[...value].some((char) => char.charCodeAt(0) < 32 && !['\t', '\n', '\r'].includes(char))
	)
		throw new Error('Invalid center text');
	return value;
}
export function centerPath(tab: CenterTab, id: string) {
	return centerTabs.includes(tab) && /^[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$/.test(id)
		? `/account/center/${tab}/${id}`
		: undefined;
}
export function decodeCenter(value: CenterContent, subject: SecuritySubject): CenterContent {
	if (!value?.subject?.scope || centerIdentity(value.subject) !== centerIdentity(subject))
		throw new Error('Mismatched center owner');
	function list(records: readonly CenterRecord[]) {
		if (!Array.isArray(records) || records.length > 50) throw new Error('Invalid center list');
		const ids = new Set<string>();
		return Object.freeze(
			records.map((record) => {
				if (
					!centerPath('articles', record.id) ||
					ids.has(record.id) ||
					!['active', 'complete', 'planned'].includes(record.status) ||
					!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(record.date) ||
					Number.isNaN(Date.parse(record.date)) ||
					new Date(record.date).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== record.date ||
					!Number.isSafeInteger(record.views) ||
					record.views < 0
				)
					throw new Error('Invalid center record');
				ids.add(record.id);
				return Object.freeze({
					id: record.id,
					title: text(record.title, 100),
					description: text(record.description),
					date: record.date,
					views: record.views,
					status: record.status,
					detail: text(record.detail, 2000)
				});
			})
		);
	}
	function tags(items: readonly string[]) {
		if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length > 12) throw new Error('Invalid center tags');
		return Object.freeze(items.map((item) => text(item, 64)));
	}
	return Object.freeze({
		subject: Object.freeze({ id: subject.id, scope: Object.freeze({ ...subject.scope }) }),
		biography: text(value.biography),
		office: text(value.office, 100),
		interests: tags(value.interests),
		teams: tags(value.teams),
		articles: list(value.articles),
		projects: list(value.projects),
		applications: list(value.applications)
	});
}

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AccountHost } from '../Types.js';
import type { CenterContent, CenterContentHost, CenterRecord, CenterTab } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountFixture } from '../examples/Fixture.js';
import { centerPath, centerTabs } from './Data.js';

export const centerModes = [
	'ready',
	'empty',
	'empty-tab',
	'error',
	'slow',
	'late',
	'invalid-owner'
] as const;
export type CenterMode = (typeof centerModes)[number];
/** Entirely local synthetic read model. No writes, storage, upload, or network API. */
export function createCenterFixture(i18n: AsamI18n) {
	const account = createAccountFixture(i18n);
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'ready' as CenterMode,
		disabled: false,
		denied: false,
		readOnly: false,
		timeoutMs: 1500,
		version: 0,
		navigationFailure: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		reads: 0,
		aborts: 0,
		lateIgnored: 0,
		navigations: [] as string[],
		disposed: false
	});
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createMemoryHistory(),
		routes: [{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: { render: () => null } }]
	});
	const contentHost: CenterContentHost = {
		get revision() {
			return JSON.stringify([
				controls.mode,
				controls.version,
				controls.denied,
				i18n.locale.value
			]);
		},
		get timeoutMs() {
			return controls.timeoutMs;
		},
		async read(subject, request) {
			audit.reads++;
			const mode = controls.mode,
				en = i18n.locale.value === 'en';
			const text = (zh: string, english: string) => (en ? english : zh);
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					audit.aborts++;
					if (mode === 'late') return;
					clearTimeout(timer);
					request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new Error('Cancelled synthetic read'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(
					() => {
						request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
						resolve();
					},
					mode === 'late' ? 2500 : mode === 'slow' ? 700 : 35
				);
				request.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (request.signal.aborted) abort();
			});
			if (!request.isCurrent()) audit.lateIgnored++;
			if (mode === 'error') throw new Error('SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_ERROR_MUST_NOT_RENDER');
			if (mode === 'empty') return null;
			const records = (kind: CenterTab): CenterRecord[] =>
				Array.from({ length: kind === 'articles' ? 3 : 4 }, (_, index) => {
					const id = index + 1;
					const titles =
						kind === 'articles'
							? [
									text(
										'让设计系统成为团队的共同语言',
										'A shared language for design'
									),
									text('从问题到方案：一次体验复盘', 'From problem to solution'),
									text(
										'在协作中发现更好的答案',
										'Finding better answers together'
									)
								]
							: kind === 'projects'
								? [
										text('协作工作空间', 'Team workspace'),
										text('设计语言升级', 'Design language upgrade'),
										text('客户服务平台', 'Customer service platform'),
										text('知识中心', 'Knowledge center')
									]
								: [
										text('团队日历', 'Team calendar'),
										text('素材管理', 'Asset library'),
										text('数据洞察', 'Data insights'),
										text('协作笔记', 'Shared notes')
									];
					return {
						id: `${kind}-${id}`,
						title: titles[index]!,
						description: text(
							'以清晰、一致的体验，帮助团队更高效地完成每一天的工作。',
							'Clear, consistent experiences that help the team work better every day.'
						),
						date: `2026-10-${String(20 - index * 3).padStart(2, '0')}`,
						views: 168 + id * 23,
						status: index === 2 ? 'planned' : index === 1 ? 'complete' : 'active',
						detail: text(
							`这是${titles[index]}的本地演示详情。\n我们梳理目标与使用场景，记录已经完成的工作，并把下一步计划分享给参与团队。所有资料均为合成内容，不连接真实业务服务。`,
							`Local demo details for ${titles[index]}.\nThe team documents its goals, completed work and next steps. All content is synthetic and no live service is connected.`
						)
					};
				});
			const value: CenterContent = {
				subject: {
					id: mode === 'invalid-owner' ? 'wrong-owner' : subject.id,
					scope: { ...subject.scope }
				},
				biography: text(
					'把复杂问题变成清晰的体验',
					'Turning complex problems into clear experiences'
				),
				office: text('研发园区 · A座', 'Research campus · Building A'),
				interests: [
					text('设计系统', 'Design systems'),
					text('用户体验', 'User experience'),
					text('团队协作', 'Collaboration')
				],
				teams: [
					text('产品体验组', 'Product experience'),
					text('研发运营组', 'Engineering operations')
				],
				articles: records('articles'),
				projects: mode === 'empty-tab' ? [] : records('projects'),
				applications: records('applications')
			};
			return value;
		}
	};
	function canNavigate(path: string) {
		return (
			path === '/account/center' ||
			centerTabs.some((kind) =>
				Array.from({ length: kind === 'articles' ? 3 : 4 }, (_, i) =>
					centerPath(kind, `${kind}-${i + 1}`)
				).includes(path)
			)
		);
	}
	const host: AccountHost = {
		...account.host,
		security: {
			...account.host.security,
			check: (rule) => (controls.denied ? 'denied' : account.host.security.check(rule))
		},
		canNavigate,
		async navigate(path) {
			if (!canNavigate(path)) return;
			if (controls.navigationFailure) throw new Error('Synthetic navigation failure');
			audit.navigations.push(path);
			await router.push(path);
		},
		services: {
			...account.host.services,
			async profile(subject, request) {
				const original = await account.host.services.profile(subject, request);
				if (!original) return null;
				const en = i18n.locale.value === 'en';
				return {
					...original,
					displayName:
						subject.id === 0
							? en
								? 'Lan Lin'
								: '林岚'
							: en
								? 'Xingzhou Gu'
								: '顾行舟',
					role: en ? 'Product experience designer' : '产品体验设计师',
					organization: en ? 'Engineering operations' : '研发运营组'
				};
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		setMode(value: CenterMode) {
			controls.mode = value;
		},
		toggleDenied() {
			controls.denied = !controls.denied;
		},
		toggleDisabled() {
			controls.disabled = !controls.disabled;
		},
		host,
		contentHost,
		controls,
		audit,
		router,
		security: account.security,
		account,
		async initialize() {
			await router.push('/account/center');
			await account.identity(0);
		},
		async identity() {
			await account.identity(account.security.state.value.subject?.id === 0 ? '0' : 0);
		},
		async readOnly() {
			controls.readOnly = !controls.readOnly;
			account.controls.readOnly = controls.readOnly;
			await account.security.refresh();
		},
		dispose() {
			if (audit.disposed) return;
			audit.disposed = true;
			account.dispose();
			router.listening = false;
		}
	};
}
export type CenterFixture = ReturnType<typeof createCenterFixture>;

import { shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { AccountHost, AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';
import type { CenterContent, CenterContentHost } from './Types.js';
import { centerIdentity, decodeCenter } from './Data.js';

/** A bounded read adapter, owned by ProfilePanel's original session/request scope.
 * No second profile/security state machine and no write service are introduced. */
export function createCenterRead(account: AccountHost, provider: () => CenterContentHost) {
	const content = shallowRef<CenterContent | null>(null);
	let revision = 0;
	let active: AbortController | undefined;
	function clear() {
		revision++;
		content.value = null;
		active?.abort();
		active = undefined;
	}
	const stop = watch(
		() => {
			const state = account.security.state.value;
			return JSON.stringify([
				state.status,
				state.epoch,
				state.subject && centerIdentity(state.subject),
				provider().revision
			]);
		},
		clear,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const unsubscribe = account.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const host: AccountHost = {
		...account,
		services: {
			...account.services,
			async profile(subject, parent) {
				clear();
				const currentRevision = revision;
				const source = provider();
				const controller = new AbortController();
				active = controller;
				const current = () =>
					parent.isCurrent() &&
					!controller.signal.aborted &&
					currentRevision === revision &&
					provider() === source;
				const request: AccountRequest = {
					operationId: parent.operationId,
					signal: controller.signal,
					isCurrent: current
				};
				const abort = () => controller.abort();
				parent.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (parent.signal.aborted) abort();
				let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
				let onAbort: (() => void) | undefined;
				try {
					const timeout = Number.isFinite(source.timeoutMs)
						? Math.min(30000, Math.max(50, source.timeoutMs!))
						: 10000;
					const interrupted = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
						onAbort = () => reject(new Error('Center read interrupted'));
						controller.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
						if (controller.signal.aborted) onAbort();
						timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);
					});
					const [profile, result] = await Promise.race([
						Promise.all([
							account.services.profile(subject, request),
							source.read(subject, request)
						]),
						interrupted
					]);
					if (!current()) throw new Error('Stale center read');
					if (!profile || !result) return null;
					content.value = decodeCenter(result, subject);
					return profile;
				} finally {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					parent.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					if (onAbort) controller.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
					if (active === controller) active = undefined;
					controller.abort();
				}
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		content,
		clear,
		dispose() {
			stop();
			unsubscribe();
			clear();
		}
	};
}

import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';

/** Page-local read model. The public account/profile protocol remains unchanged. */
export type CenterTab = 'articles' | 'projects' | 'applications';
export interface CenterRecord {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly date: string;
	readonly views: number;
	readonly status: 'active' | 'complete' | 'planned';
	readonly detail: string;
}
export interface CenterContent {
	readonly subject: Pick<SecuritySubject, 'id' | 'scope'>;
	readonly biography: string;
	readonly office: string;
	readonly interests: readonly string[];
	readonly teams: readonly string[];
	readonly articles: readonly CenterRecord[];
	readonly projects: readonly CenterRecord[];
	readonly applications: readonly CenterRecord[];
}
export interface CenterContentHost {
	/** Change when the provider or its input changes; old responses are invalidated. */
	readonly revision: string | number;
	readonly timeoutMs?: number;
	read(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<CenterContent | null>;
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createCenterFixture } from './Fixture.js';

export async function mountAccountCenter(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const fixture = createCenterFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'account-center-demo' });
	app.use(fixture.router);
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	LoginCredentials,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	WriteResult
} from '../Types.js';
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

export const exampleBrand = 'ASAM';
export const exampleAccountLabel = '账户';
export type FixtureMode = 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown' | 'empty' | 'late';
/** Synthetic local adapter. No fetch, URL, cookie, token, storage or real account. */
export function createAccountFixture(
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	profileFields?: Pick<AccountSettings, 'biography' | 'officeArea'>
) {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'success' as FixtureMode,
		delay: 0,
		refreshFailure: false,
		readOnly: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		login: 0,
		lastAccount: '',
		register: 0,
		save: 0,
		profile: 0,
		settings: 0,
		verify: 0,
		refresh: 0,
		disposed: false,
		navigations: [] as string[],
		escalations: [] as string[]
	});
	let sequence = 0;
	let currentId: string | number = 0;
	let profileName = '林予安';
	let settings: AccountSettings = {
		displayName: '林予安',
		email: 'lin@example.invalid',
		phone: '+86 010 5555 0186',
		language: 'zh-CN',
		notifications: true,
		digest: false,
		...(typeof profileFields?.biography === 'string'
			? { biography: profileFields.biography }
			: {}),
		...(typeof profileFields?.officeArea === 'string'
			? { officeArea: profileFields.officeArea }
			: {})
	};
	const operations = new Map<string, WriteResult<SettingsField | RegistrationField>>();
	const wait = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	const subject = (): SecuritySubject => ({
		id: currentId,
		name: profileName,
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: ['account:read', 'account:write'],
		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: 0, label: '演示团队' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: '0', label: '演示团队 B' }
		],
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000,
		readOnly: controls.readOnly
	});
	const security = createSecurity<LoginCredentials & { caller: AccountRequest }>({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			async login(credentials, request) {
				audit.login++;
				audit.lastAccount = credentials.account;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !credentials.caller.isCurrent())
					throw new Error('Cancelled');
				if (controls.mode === 'failure') throw new Error('Synthetic failure');
				return subject();
			},
			async restore(request) {
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent() ? subject() : null;
			},
			async refresh(_subject, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return subject();
			},
			async switchContext(person, scope, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return { ...person, scope };
			},
			async logout() {
				await wait();
			}
		}
	});
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n,
		transport: async (input) => {
			const mode = controls.mode;
			const delay = controls.delay;
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
			if (mode === 'failure') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (input.url === 'fixture:profile') {
				audit.profile++;
				const person = input.data as SecuritySubject;
				return {
					mode: 'data',
					data:
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: {
									displayName: person.id === 0 ? profileName : '顾行舟',
									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',
									joined: '2026-10-01',
									secret: 'must-not-render'
								}
				};
			}
			if (input.url === 'fixture:settings') {
				audit.settings++;
				return { mode: 'data', data: { ...settings } };
			}
			throw new TransportFault('unknown');
		}
	});
	const host: AccountHost = {
		security,
		operationId: () => `synthetic-${++sequence}`,
		canNavigate: (path) => ['/account/profile', '/account/settings'].includes(path),
		navigate: (path) => {
			audit.navigations.push(path);
		},
		resolveUnknown: (kind, id) => {
			audit.escalations.push(`${kind}:${id}`);
		},
		services: {
			login: (credentials, caller) => security.login({ ...credentials, caller }),
			async register(input, request) {
				audit.register++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<RegistrationField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '该邮箱已用于合成账户' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示注册失败，可修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: `账户 ${input.account} 已创建` };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async profile(person, request) {
				// Each page read owns a Latest wrapper, never a shared mutable global request slot.
				const latest = createLatestRequest<AccountProfile | null>(client, () => undefined);
				try {
					return await latest.load(
						{ url: 'fixture:profile', data: person },
						{
							signal: request.signal,
							decode: (value) => value as AccountProfile | null
						}
					);
				} finally {
					latest.dispose();
				}
			},
			settings: (_person, request) =>
				client.request(
					{ url: 'fixture:settings' },
					{ signal: request.signal, decode: (value) => value as AccountSettings }
				),
			async save(_person, input, request) {
				audit.save++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<SettingsField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '此邮箱未通过应用规则' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: '账户设置已保存' };
				if (result.status === 'success') settings = { ...input };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async verifyRegistration(id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<RegistrationField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async verifySave(_subject, id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<SettingsField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async refreshDisplay(_subject, request) {
				audit.refresh++;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || controls.refreshFailure)
					throw new Error('Synthetic display failure');
				profileName = settings.displayName;
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		security,
		client,
		async identity(id: string | number) {
			currentId = id;
			await security.restore();
		},
		dispose() {
			audit.disposed = true;
			security.dispose();
			client.dispose();
		}
	};
}

<template>
	<section class="account-profile" :data-account-state="data.profileStatus.value">
		<slot
			:profile="data.profile.value"
			:status="data.profileStatus.value"
			:allowed="data.allowed()"
			:refresh="() => data.loadProfile(disabled)"
			:clear="data.clear"
			><h1>{{ title }}</h1>
			<p class="account-intro">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.profileIntro') }}</p>
			<p v-if="!data.allowed()" role="status">
				{{
					host.security.state.value.status === 'expired'
						? i18n.t('app.templates.account.expired')
						: i18n.t('app.templates.account.profileDenied')
				}}
			</p>
			<template v-else
				><p v-if="data.profileStatus.value === 'loading'" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.profileLoading') }}
				</p>
				<p v-if="data.profileStatus.value === 'error'" role="alert">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.profileFailed') }}
				</p>
				<p v-if="data.profileStatus.value === 'empty'" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.profileEmpty') }}
				</p>
				<template v-if="data.profile.value"
					><div class="account-person">
						<img
							v-if="avatar && !avatarFailed"
							:src="avatar"
							:alt="i18n.t('app.templates.account.avatar')"
							referrerpolicy="no-referrer"
							@error="avatarFailed = true"
						/><span
							v-else
							class="account-avatar"
							:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.textAvatar')"
							>{{ data.profile.value.displayName.slice(0, 1) || 'A' }}</span
						>
						<div class="account-person-info">
							<h2>
								{{
									data.profile.value.displayName ||
									i18n.t('app.templates.account.unnamed')
								}}
							</h2>
							<p>
								{{
									data.profile.value.organization ||
									i18n.t('app.templates.account.noOrganization')
								}}
							</p>
						</div>
					</div>
					<dl class="account-details">
						<div v-for="field in fields" :key="field.key">
							<dt>{{ field.label }}</dt>
							<dd>
								{{
									data.profile.value[field.key] ||
									i18n.t('app.templates.account.notProvided')
								}}
							</dd>
						</div>
					</dl>
					<a
						v-if="data.profile.value.website"
						:href="data.profile.value.website"
						rel="noopener noreferrer"
						target="_blank"
						:aria-disabled="disabled"
						@click="disabled && $event.preventDefault()"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.website') }}</a
					></template
				>
				<div class="account-actions">
					<AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || data.profileStatus.value === 'loading'"
						@click="data.loadProfile(disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.reload') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('page', 'settings')"
						>{{
							data.allowed(true)
								? i18n.t('app.templates.account.editSettings')
								: i18n.t('app.templates.account.viewSettings')
						}}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></template
			><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				v-if="!data.allowed()"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="emit('page', 'login')"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.goLogin') }}</AsamButton
			></slot
		>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AccountPageEvents, AccountPageProps } from '../Types.js';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<AccountPageProps & { title: string; refreshKey?: string | number }>(),
	{
		size: 'default',
		refreshKey: undefined
	}
);
const emit = defineEmits<AccountPageEvents>();
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n);
const avatarFailed = ref(false);
const avatar = computed(() => data.profile.value?.avatar);
const fields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'organization',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.organization');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'role',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.role');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'joined',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.joined');
		}
	}
] as const;
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.refreshKey],
	() => {
		avatarFailed.value = false;
		// Optional composed views invalidate the same existing request scope before rereading.
		if (props.refreshKey !== undefined) data.clear();
		void data.loadProfile(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(data.dispose);
defineExpose({ clear: data.clear });
</script>

import { computed, reactive, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { accountMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { safeReturnPath, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
const emptySettings = () => ({
	displayName: '',
	email: '',
	phone: '',
	language: 'zh-CN',
	notifications: false,
	digest: false
});
const text = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '');
export function safeProfile(value) {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		organization: text(value.organization),
		role: text(value.role),
		joined: text(value.joined),
		avatar: safeAccountUrl(value.avatar),
		website: safeAccountUrl(value.website)
	};
}
/** No data/blob/protocol-relative URLs. Host should restrict remote hosts further. */
export function safeAccountUrl(value) {
	// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Reject URL control characters, as before.
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || /[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(value)) return;
	if (value.startsWith('/') && !value.startsWith('//') && !/%[0-9a-f]{2}/i.test(value))
		return value;
	try {
		const url = new URL(value);
		return url.protocol === 'https:' && !url.username && !url.password ? url.href : undefined;
	} catch {
		return;
	}
}
function copySettings(value) {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),
		notifications: value.notifications === true,
		digest: value.digest === true,
		...(typeof value.biography === 'string' ? { biography: value.biography } : {}),
		...(typeof value.officeArea === 'string' ? { officeArea: value.officeArea } : {})
	};
}
function feedback(owner) {
	const scope = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, accountMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const message = ref('');
	const source = shallowRef();
	const sources = shallowRef({});
	const errors = ref({});
	function setMessage(legacy, ...call) {
		message.value = legacy;
		source.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	return {
		message,
		errors,
		sources,
		setMessage,
		displayMessage: computed(() =>
			scope && source.value ? formatFieldIssue(source.value, scope) : message.value
		),
		displayErrors: computed(() =>
			Object.fromEntries(
				Object.entries(errors.value).map(([key, value]) => [
					key,
					scope && sources.value[key]
						? formatFieldIssue(sources.value[key], scope)
						: value
				])
			)
		),
		dispose: () => scope?.dispose()
	};
}
export function registrationIssues(host, value, sources = {}) {
	const errors = {};
	function add(field, legacy, ...call) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_.-]{3,40}$/u.test(value.account))
		add(
			'account',
			'用户名需为3至40个字母、数字或 _ . -',
			'app.templates.account.accountInvalid'
		);
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.password.length < (host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8))
		add(
			'password',
			`密码至少${host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8}位`,
			'app.templates.account.passwordShort',
			{ minimum: host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8 }
		);
	if (value.password !== value.confirm)
		add('confirm', '两次输入的密码不一致', 'app.templates.account.passwordMismatch');
	if (host.registration?.requireConsent !== false && !value.consent)
		add('consent', '请先同意账户使用条款', 'app.templates.account.consentRequired');
	const hostErrors = host.registration?.validate?.(value);
	for (const key of Object.keys(hostErrors ?? {})) delete sources[key];
	return { ...errors, ...hostErrors };
}
export function settingsIssues(value, host, sources = {}) {
	const errors = {};
	function add(field, legacy, ...call) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!value.displayName.trim() || value.displayName.length > 60)
		add('displayName', '显示名需为1至60个字符', 'app.templates.account.nameInvalid');
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.phone && !/^[+\d ()-]{5,30}$/.test(value.phone))
		add('phone', '请填写有效联系电话或留空', 'app.templates.account.phoneInvalid');
	if (
		!(host.languages ?? [{ value: 'zh-CN' }, { value: 'en' }]).some(
			(i) => i.value === value.language
		)
	)
		add('language', '请选择支持的语言', 'app.templates.account.languageInvalid');
	return errors;
}

export function createRegistration(host, i18n) {

		email: '',
		password: '',
		confirm: '',

	const operationId = ref('');

		draft.password = '';

			setMessage('字段校验未能完成', 'app.templates.account.validationFailed');
			return false;
		}
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			status.value = 'field-error';
			return false;
		}
		const input = {
			account: draft.account,
			email: draft.email,
			password: draft.password,
			consent: draft.consent
		};
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);

			const result = await host.services.register(input, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) return false;
			accept(result);

			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });

		} finally {
			input.password = '';
			request.release();
		}

		if (blocked || status.value !== 'unknown' || !host.services.verifyRegistration)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.verifyRegistration(operationId.value, request);

					setMessage(
						'已核实未写入，可重新填写密码后提交',
						'app.templates.account.registrationNotWritten'
					);
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}

		draft,
		status,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		submit,
		verify,
		secretClear,

export function loginDestination(host, value) {
	const path = safeReturnPath(value, '/account/profile');
	return host.canNavigate(path) ? path : undefined;

							:body-style="{ padding: 'var(--asam-space-lg,24px)' }"
							><div class="center-identity">

									profile.displayName.slice(0, 1) || 'A'
								}}</AsamAvatar>

								<p>{{ read.content.value.biography }}</p>
								<AsamTag type="primary">{{ profile.role }}</AsamTag>
							</div>
							<AsamDivider /><AsamDescriptions :column="1" direction="vertical"
								><AsamDescriptionsItem :rowspan="1" :label="t('team')">{{
									profile.organization
								}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
								><AsamDescriptionsItem :rowspan="1" :label="t('office')">{{
									read.content.value.office
								}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
								><AsamDescriptionsItem :rowspan="1" :label="t('email')">{{
									profile.email
								}}</AsamDescriptionsItem></AsamDescriptions
							><AsamDivider />
							<h3>{{ t('interests') }}</h3>

							<AsamButton

								type="primary"
								:size="size"
								v-bind="teamsToggleAttrs"
								@click="teamsExpanded = !teamsExpanded"
								>{{ t('teams') }}</AsamButton
							>
							<div
								:id="teamsId"
								class="center-teams"
								:class="{ 'center-teams-collapsed': !teamsExpanded }"
							>
								<div
									v-for="team in read.content.value.teams"
									:key="team"
									class="center-team"

									<AsamAvatar :size="28" shape="square">{{
										team.slice(0, 1)
									}}</AsamAvatar
									><span>{{ team }}</span>

							</div></AsamCard
						>
					</aside>
					<AsamCard
						bordered
						shadow="never"
						class="center-content"
						:body-style="{ padding: 'var(--asam-space-lg,24px)' }"
						><template v-if="path === '/account/center'"
							><div class="center-tabs">
								<AsamTabs
									:model-value="tab"
									:items="tabs"
									:aria-label="t('content')"
									@update:model-value="setTab"
								/>
							</div>
							<section :aria-label="t(tab)" class="center-results" tabindex="-1">
								<p v-if="!records.length" role="status">{{ t('emptyTab') }}</p>
								<template v-else-if="tab === 'articles'"
									><article
										v-for="item in records"
										:key="item.id"
										class="center-article"
									>
										<AsamLink
											type="primary"
											:href="centerPath(tab, item.id)"
											:disabled="disabled || !canOpen(tab, item.id)"
											@click.prevent="open(tab, item.id)"
											><h2>{{ item.title }}</h2></AsamLink
										>
										<p>{{ item.description }}</p>
										<div class="center-meta">
											<time :datetime="item.date">{{
												formatDate(item.date)
											}}</time
											><span
												>{{ t('views') }}
												{{ number.format(item.views) }}</span

										</div>
									</article></template
								><AsamCardGroup
									v-else
									:key="tab"
									:min-width="240"
									columns="auto"
									layout="grid"
									:label="t(tab)"
									class="center-projects"
									><AsamCard
										v-for="item in records"
										:key="item.id"
										:title="item.title"
										bordered
										shadow="never"
										class="center-project-card"
										><p>{{ item.description }}</p>
										<AsamTag
											:type="
												item.status === 'complete'
													? 'success'
													: item.status === 'planned'
														? 'info'
														: 'primary'
											"
											>{{ t(item.status) }}</AsamTag
										><template #footer
											><AsamButton
												type="primary"
												text
												:size="size"
												:disabled="disabled || !canOpen(tab, item.id)"

													· {{ item.title }}</span

								<p>{{ selected.record.detail }}</p>
								<div class="center-meta">
									<time :datetime="selected.record.date">{{
										formatDate(selected.record.date)

										{{ number.format(selected.record.views) }}</span
									>

								type="primary"

								>{{ t('back') }}</AsamButton
							>

				</div>
				<p v-if="navigationFailed" role="alert">{{ t('navigationFailed') }}</p></template
			></template
		></ProfilePanel
	>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAvatar,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamDescriptions,
	AsamDescriptionsItem,
	AsamDivider,
	AsamLink,
	AsamTabs,
	AsamTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCardGroup } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { centerPath, centerTabs } from './Data.js';
import { createCenterRead } from './Read.js';
import { useCenterText } from './I18n.js';
import ProfilePanel from '../shared/ProfilePanel.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false },
	contentHost: { type: Object, required: true },
	path: { type: String, required: false, default: '/account/center' }
});
const { i18n, t } = useCenterText();
const read = createCenterRead(props.host, () => props.contentHost);
const tab = ref('articles');
watch(
	[() => props.host.security, () => props.host.security.state.value.epoch],
	() => {
		tab.value = 'articles';
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
const navigationFailed = ref(false);
const teamsExpanded = ref(false);
const teamsId = useId();
const teamsToggleAttrs = computed(() => ({
	'aria-controls': teamsId,
	'aria-expanded': teamsExpanded.value
}));
const detailHeading = ref();
const number = computed(() => new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.locale.value));
const tabs = computed(() => centerTabs.map((value) => ({ value, label: t(value) })));
const records = computed(() => read.content.value?.[tab.value] ?? []);
function setTab(value) {
	if (centerTabs.includes(value)) tab.value = value;
}
const selected = computed(() => {
	for (const kind of centerTabs) {
		const record = read.content.value?.[kind].find(
			(item) => centerPath(kind, item.id) === props.path
		);
		if (record) return { tab: kind, record };
	}
	return undefined;
});
function formatDate(value) {
	return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(i18n.locale.value, {
		timeZone: 'UTC',
		year: 'numeric',
		month: 'short',
		day: 'numeric'
	}).format(new Date(value + 'T00:00:00Z'));
}
function canOpen(kind, id) {
	const path = centerPath(kind, id);
	return !!path && props.host.canNavigate(path);
}
async function navigate(path) {
	if (
		props.disabled ||
		!read.content.value ||
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) !== 'allowed' ||
		!props.host.canNavigate(path)
	)
		return;
	navigationFailed.value = false;
	const snapshot = read.content.value;
	try {
		await props.host.navigate(path);
	} catch {
		if (snapshot === read.content.value) navigationFailed.value = true;
	}
}
function open(kind, id) {
	const path = centerPath(kind, id);
	if (path) void navigate(path);
}
function back() {
	void navigate('/account/center');
}
watch(
	() => props.path,
	async () => {
		navigationFailed.value = false;
		await nextTick();
		detailHeading.value?.focus();
	}
);
onBeforeUnmount(read.dispose);
watch(
	() => props.disabled,
	(disabled) => {
		if (disabled) read.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	read.content,
	(value) => {
		if (value) return;
		navigationFailed.value = false;
		teamsExpanded.value = false;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
</script>

export const centerTabs = ['articles', 'projects', 'applications'];
export function centerIdentity(subject) {
	return JSON.stringify([subject.id, subject.scope.tenant, subject.scope.organization]);
}
function text(value, max = 500) {
	if (
		typeof value !== 'string' ||
		value.length > max ||
		[...value].some((char) => char.charCodeAt(0) < 32 && !['\t', '\n', '\r'].includes(char))
	)
		throw new Error('Invalid center text');
	return value;
}
export function centerPath(tab, id) {
	return centerTabs.includes(tab) && /^[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$/.test(id)
		? `/account/center/${tab}/${id}`
		: undefined;
}
export function decodeCenter(value, subject) {
	if (!value?.subject?.scope || centerIdentity(value.subject) !== centerIdentity(subject))
		throw new Error('Mismatched center owner');
	function list(records) {
		if (!Array.isArray(records) || records.length > 50) throw new Error('Invalid center list');
		const ids = new Set();
		return Object.freeze(
			records.map((record) => {
				if (
					!centerPath('articles', record.id) ||
					ids.has(record.id) ||
					!['active', 'complete', 'planned'].includes(record.status) ||
					!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(record.date) ||
					Number.isNaN(Date.parse(record.date)) ||
					new Date(record.date).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== record.date ||
					!Number.isSafeInteger(record.views) ||
					record.views < 0
				)
					throw new Error('Invalid center record');
				ids.add(record.id);
				return Object.freeze({
					id: record.id,
					title: text(record.title, 100),
					description: text(record.description),
					date: record.date,
					views: record.views,
					status: record.status,
					detail: text(record.detail, 2000)
				});
			})
		);
	}
	function tags(items) {
		if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length > 12) throw new Error('Invalid center tags');
		return Object.freeze(items.map((item) => text(item, 64)));
	}
	return Object.freeze({
		subject: Object.freeze({ id: subject.id, scope: Object.freeze({ ...subject.scope }) }),
		biography: text(value.biography),
		office: text(value.office, 100),
		interests: tags(value.interests),
		teams: tags(value.teams),
		articles: list(value.articles),
		projects: list(value.projects),
		applications: list(value.applications)
	});
}
