import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { createAccountFixture } from '../examples/Fixture.js';
import { centerPath, centerTabs } from './Data.js';
export const centerModes = [
	'ready',
	'empty',
	'empty-tab',
	'error',
	'slow',
	'late',
	'invalid-owner'
];
/** Entirely local synthetic read model. No writes, storage, upload, or network API. */
export function createCenterFixture(i18n) {
	const account = createAccountFixture(i18n);
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'ready',
		disabled: false,
		denied: false,
		readOnly: false,
		timeoutMs: 1500,
		version: 0,
		navigationFailure: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		reads: 0,
		aborts: 0,
		lateIgnored: 0,
		navigations: [],
		disposed: false
	});
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createMemoryHistory(),
		routes: [{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: { render: () => null } }]
	});
	const contentHost = {
		get revision() {
			return JSON.stringify([
				controls.mode,
				controls.version,
				controls.denied,
				i18n.locale.value
			]);
		},
		get timeoutMs() {
			return controls.timeoutMs;
		},
		async read(subject, request) {
			audit.reads++;
			const mode = controls.mode,
				en = i18n.locale.value === 'en';
			const text = (zh, english) => (en ? english : zh);
			await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					audit.aborts++;
					if (mode === 'late') return;
					clearTimeout(timer);
					request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new Error('Cancelled synthetic read'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(
					() => {
						request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
						resolve();
					},
					mode === 'late' ? 2500 : mode === 'slow' ? 700 : 35
				);
				request.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (request.signal.aborted) abort();
			});
			if (!request.isCurrent()) audit.lateIgnored++;
			if (mode === 'error') throw new Error('SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_ERROR_MUST_NOT_RENDER');
			if (mode === 'empty') return null;
			const records = (kind) =>
				Array.from({ length: kind === 'articles' ? 3 : 4 }, (_, index) => {
					const id = index + 1;
					const titles =
						kind === 'articles'
							? [
									text(
										'让设计系统成为团队的共同语言',
										'A shared language for design'
									),
									text('从问题到方案：一次体验复盘', 'From problem to solution'),
									text(
										'在协作中发现更好的答案',
										'Finding better answers together'
									)
								]
							: kind === 'projects'
								? [
										text('协作工作空间', 'Team workspace'),
										text('设计语言升级', 'Design language upgrade'),
										text('客户服务平台', 'Customer service platform'),
										text('知识中心', 'Knowledge center')
									]
								: [
										text('团队日历', 'Team calendar'),
										text('素材管理', 'Asset library'),
										text('数据洞察', 'Data insights'),
										text('协作笔记', 'Shared notes')
									];
					return {
						id: `${kind}-${id}`,
						title: titles[index],
						description: text(
							'以清晰、一致的体验，帮助团队更高效地完成每一天的工作。',
							'Clear, consistent experiences that help the team work better every day.'
						),
						date: `2026-10-${String(20 - index * 3).padStart(2, '0')}`,
						views: 168 + id * 23,
						status: index === 2 ? 'planned' : index === 1 ? 'complete' : 'active',
						detail: text(
							`这是${titles[index]}的本地演示详情。\n我们梳理目标与使用场景，记录已经完成的工作，并把下一步计划分享给参与团队。所有资料均为合成内容，不连接真实业务服务。`,
							`Local demo details for ${titles[index]}.\nThe team documents its goals, completed work and next steps. All content is synthetic and no live service is connected.`
						)
					};
				});
			const value = {
				subject: {
					id: mode === 'invalid-owner' ? 'wrong-owner' : subject.id,
					scope: { ...subject.scope }
				},
				biography: text(
					'把复杂问题变成清晰的体验',
					'Turning complex problems into clear experiences'
				),
				office: text('研发园区 · A座', 'Research campus · Building A'),
				interests: [
					text('设计系统', 'Design systems'),
					text('用户体验', 'User experience'),
					text('团队协作', 'Collaboration')
				],
				teams: [
					text('产品体验组', 'Product experience'),
					text('研发运营组', 'Engineering operations')
				],
				articles: records('articles'),
				projects: mode === 'empty-tab' ? [] : records('projects'),
				applications: records('applications')
			};
			return value;
		}
	};
	function canNavigate(path) {
		return (
			path === '/account/center' ||
			centerTabs.some((kind) =>
				Array.from({ length: kind === 'articles' ? 3 : 4 }, (_, i) =>
					centerPath(kind, `${kind}-${i + 1}`)
				).includes(path)
			)
		);
	}
	const host = {
		...account.host,
		security: {
			...account.host.security,
			check: (rule) => (controls.denied ? 'denied' : account.host.security.check(rule))
		},
		canNavigate,
		async navigate(path) {
			if (!canNavigate(path)) return;
			if (controls.navigationFailure) throw new Error('Synthetic navigation failure');
			audit.navigations.push(path);
			await router.push(path);
		},
		services: {
			...account.host.services,
			async profile(subject, request) {
				const original = await account.host.services.profile(subject, request);
				if (!original) return null;
				const en = i18n.locale.value === 'en';
				return {
					...original,
					displayName:
						subject.id === 0
							? en
								? 'Lan Lin'
								: '林岚'
							: en
								? 'Xingzhou Gu'
								: '顾行舟',
					role: en ? 'Product experience designer' : '产品体验设计师',
					organization: en ? 'Engineering operations' : '研发运营组'
				};
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		setMode(value) {
			controls.mode = value;
		},

		contentHost,

import { shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { centerIdentity, decodeCenter } from './Data.js';
/** A bounded read adapter, owned by ProfilePanel's original session/request scope.
 * No second profile/security state machine and no write service are introduced. */
export function createCenterRead(account, provider) {
	const content = shallowRef(null);
	let revision = 0;
	let active;
	function clear() {
		revision++;
		content.value = null;
		active?.abort();
		active = undefined;
	}
	const stop = watch(
		() => {
			const state = account.security.state.value;
			return JSON.stringify([
				state.status,
				state.epoch,
				state.subject && centerIdentity(state.subject),
				provider().revision
			]);
		},
		clear,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const unsubscribe = account.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const host = {
		...account,
		services: {
			...account.services,
			async profile(subject, parent) {
				clear();
				const currentRevision = revision;
				const source = provider();
				const controller = new AbortController();
				active = controller;
				const current = () =>
					parent.isCurrent() &&
					!controller.signal.aborted &&
					currentRevision === revision &&
					provider() === source;
				const request = {
					operationId: parent.operationId,
					signal: controller.signal,
					isCurrent: current
				};
				const abort = () => controller.abort();
				parent.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (parent.signal.aborted) abort();
				let timer;
				let onAbort;
				try {
					const timeout = Number.isFinite(source.timeoutMs)
						? Math.min(30000, Math.max(50, source.timeoutMs))
						: 10000;
					const interrupted = new Promise((_, reject) => {
						onAbort = () => reject(new Error('Center read interrupted'));
						controller.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
						if (controller.signal.aborted) onAbort();
						timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);
					});
					const [profile, result] = await Promise.race([
						Promise.all([
							account.services.profile(subject, request),
							source.read(subject, request)
						]),
						interrupted
					]);
					if (!current()) throw new Error('Stale center read');
					if (!profile || !result) return null;
					content.value = decodeCenter(result, subject);
					return profile;
				} finally {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					parent.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					if (onAbort) controller.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
					if (active === controller) active = undefined;
					controller.abort();
				}
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		content,
		clear,
		dispose() {
			stop();
			unsubscribe();
			clear();
		}
	};
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createCenterFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export async function mountAccountCenter(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const fixture = createCenterFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'account-center-demo' });
	app.use(fixture.router);
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
export const exampleBrand = 'ASAM';
export const exampleAccountLabel = '账户';
/** Synthetic local adapter. No fetch, URL, cookie, token, storage or real account. */
export function createAccountFixture(i18n, profileFields) {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'success',
		delay: 0,
		refreshFailure: false,
		readOnly: false

	const audit = reactive({
		login: 0,
		lastAccount: '',
		register: 0,
		save: 0,
		profile: 0,
		settings: 0,
		verify: 0,
		refresh: 0,
		disposed: false,
		navigations: [],

		phone: '+86 010 5555 0186',
		language: 'zh-CN',

		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: ['account:read', 'account:write'],
		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: 0, label: '演示团队' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: '0', label: '演示团队 B' }

		readOnly: controls.readOnly

		i18n,
		adapter: {

				await wait();

			},

				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return subject();
			},
			async switchContext(person, scope, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return { ...person, scope };
			},
			async logout() {
				await wait();
			}
		}
	});

		i18n,
		transport: async (input) => {
			const mode = controls.mode;
			const delay = controls.delay;
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
			if (mode === 'failure') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (input.url === 'fixture:profile') {
				audit.profile++;
				const person = input.data;
				return {
					mode: 'data',
					data:
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: {
									displayName: person.id === 0 ? profileName : '顾行舟',
									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',
									joined: '2026-10-01',
									secret: 'must-not-render'
								}

			}
			if (input.url === 'fixture:settings') {

		security,
		operationId: () => `synthetic-${++sequence}`,

		navigate: (path) => {
			audit.navigations.push(path);
		},
		resolveUnknown: (kind, id) => {
			audit.escalations.push(`${kind}:${id}`);
		},
		services: {
			login: (credentials, caller) => security.login({ ...credentials, caller }),
			async register(input, request) {
				audit.register++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '该邮箱已用于合成账户' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示注册失败，可修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: `账户 ${input.account} 已创建` };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async profile(person, request) {
				// Each page read owns a Latest wrapper, never a shared mutable global request slot.
				const latest = createLatestRequest(client, () => undefined);

							signal: request.signal,

					);

				}
			},
			settings: (_person, request) =>

			async save(_person, input, request) {
				audit.save++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '此邮箱未通过应用规则' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }

				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;

				audit.refresh++;

		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		security,
		client,
		async identity(id) {
			currentId = id;

		},
		dispose() {
			audit.disposed = true;
			security.dispose();
			client.dispose();
		}
	};

	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	refreshKey: { type: [String, Number], required: false, default: undefined }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['page', 'completed']);
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n);
const avatarFailed = ref(false);
const avatar = computed(() => data.profile.value?.avatar);
const fields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'organization',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.organization');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'role',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.role');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'joined',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.joined');
		}
	}
];
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.refreshKey],
	() => {
		avatarFailed.value = false;
		// Optional composed views invalidate the same existing request scope before rereading.
		if (props.refreshKey !== undefined) data.clear();
		void data.loadProfile(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(data.dispose);
defineExpose({ clear: data.clear });
</script>

个人中心包含个人资料、关注领域和团队，以及文章、项目、应用三个内容分区。列表和详情来自同一个只读快照；链接和按钮通过宿主白名单导航。

数据与生命周期

页面组合原ProfilePanel，保留AccountHost与session状态。页面本地内容模型补充文章、项目、应用，不修改公共账户DTO。刷新、取消、期限、身份、scope、服务revision、权限、禁用和卸载隔离迟到响应；错误只显示公共文案。

布局与访问

项目与应用真实使用AsamCardGroup（minWidth240、auto列、grid）和AsamCard。支持390窄屏、暗色、四档尺寸与中英文。只读仍可查看详情，不提供真实写动作。

接入边界

宿主保持AccountHost引用稳定，替换宿主应重新挂载；替换内容服务要更新revision。演示内容、身份及路由全部为本地合成。正常包工程、源码展示、复制、ZIP及运行同源。JS checkJs=false不代表JS脚本类型检查通过。
